requirements.desc: `draft-gate` step guidance must instruct the operator to confirm `draft.json.approval.approved` is true and `approval.confirmedAt` is set before running `sdd-forge flow run gate --phase draft` when no unresolved user decision remains.

The guidance must preserve the existing validation contract: it must not tell users to bypass `DraftApproval.validate()`, loosen draft-gate approval checks, or approve a draft while a `requires_user_decision` item remains unresolved.
The corrected pre-draft-gate approval setup guidance must be verifiable through `src/flow/prompts/plan/draft-gate.md` and the `sdd-forge flow get next-action` instructions for the `draft-gate` step.
